page.overview:
What is Fletchinder?

Fletchinder is a sparrow-like bird Pokémon. The feathers covering the top part of its body are a vivid fire-red hue, while its underside is gray. Its wings are black with feathery yellow tips. It has a black white-striped tail, and black legs and talons. Its eyes are black with yellow patterns on either side, and it has a sharply pointed black beak.

Fletchinder are extremely aggressive and territorial birds that always fight amongst themselves over ownership of feeding grounds. Their main diet is bug Pokémon, which they hunt by scattering embers through the tall grass to lure out and gobble up. Some of the more intrepid Fletchinder prefer launching themselves at dens, before killing their frightened prey with thier talons.

Fletchinder rely on their bellies' flame sacs to generate flight velocity. The hotter their bellies, the faster they can fly, though such a process requires some time for a Fletchinder to achieve. Regardless, they are prided to be one of the fastest candidates among the known bird Pokémon.

Fletchinder also have rather strong talons, which are capable of slashing their panicking prey. They also can breathe embers from their beaks for hunting prey.
